BY THE COURT:
Julie Wang has previously been found to be a vexatious litigant and is subject to a
prefiling order. Ms. Wang seeks to appeal from several trial court orders, including a
February 9, 2009 order dismissing her action against defendant Andrine K. Smith.
Because the original vexatious litigant order, filed on September 23, 2008, arises out of
the same underlying superior court action, Ms. Wang need not obtain permission to
proceed with the appeal. (See People v. Harrison (2001) 92 Cal.App.4th 780, 785, fn. 6;
In re Bittaker (1997) 55 Cal.App.4th 1004, 1008.) Accordingly, the clerk of this court
and the clerk of the superior court are directed to proceed with the processing of the
appeal. |
